capabilities.name: finishing.folding
capabilities.description: Folding constraints only; never implies binding or printing.

max_folds.description: Maximum folds in one configured pass.

capabilities.name: finishing.binding
capabilities.description: Binding constraints only; never implies folding or printing.

capabilities.name: finishing.through_cut
capabilities.description: Separates material through its declared thickness in one selected configuration. It does not submit or execute a cutting job.

configured_tool_id.description: Stable adapter-local identifier of the tool selected in this configuration.

tool_type.description: Declared class of the selected tool, not a universal tool registry.

methods.description: Precisely named through-cut methods admitted by this configuration.

material_types.description: Material classes covered by this selected tool and configuration.

max_width.description: Maximum work width for the selected configuration.

max_height.description: Maximum work height for the selected configuration.

min_material_thickness.description: Minimum material thickness for the selected configuration.

max_material_thickness.description: Maximum material thickness for the selected configuration.

capabilities.name: finishing.kiss_cut
capabilities.description: Cuts the declared face layer while retaining its declared backing in one selected configuration. It is distinct from through cutting and does not execute work.

configured_tool_id.description: Stable adapter-local identifier of the selected tool.

tool_type.description: Declared class of the selected tool, not a universal tool registry.

methods.description: Precisely named kiss-cut methods admitted by this configuration.

material_types.description: Face-and-backing material classes covered by this selected configuration.

max_width.description: Maximum work width for the selected configuration.

max_height.description: Maximum work height for the selected configuration.

capabilities.name: finishing.creasing
capabilities.description: Creates a crease in a selected configuration. A crease does not imply folding, binding, or a physical result.

configured_tool_id.description: Stable adapter-local identifier of the selected tool.

tool_type.description: Declared class of the selected tool, not a universal tool registry.

methods.description: Precisely named creasing methods admitted by this configuration.

material_types.description: Material classes covered by this selected configuration.

max_width.description: Maximum work width for the selected configuration.

max_height.description: Maximum work height for the selected configuration.

min_material_thickness.description: Minimum material thickness for the selected configuration.

max_material_thickness.description: Maximum material thickness for the selected configuration.

capabilities.name: finishing.perforation
capabilities.description: Creates a declared perforation pattern in one selected configuration. It does not imply through cutting, folding, or physical completion.

configured_tool_id.description: Stable adapter-local identifier of the selected tool.

tool_type.description: Declared class of the selected tool, not a universal tool registry.

methods.description: Precisely named perforation methods admitted by this configuration.

material_types.description: Material classes covered by this selected configuration.

max_width.description: Maximum work width for the selected configuration.

max_height.description: Maximum work height for the selected configuration.

min_material_thickness.description: Minimum material thickness for the selected configuration.

max_material_thickness.description: Maximum material thickness for the selected configuration.
